title: Notary part a: the retract verb as designed in T-406 (decision 4)
description: Build exactly the handoff list of .harness/design-T-406-retraction.md. The live retraction of the 2026-08-17 false verdict is T-460, not this task.
acceptance_criteria: RETRACT_KIND = 'retract' is unprivileged and needs no intent.
retract(root, name, key_path, target_seq, reason) signs an act whose body carries retracts (digest), retracts_seq and a non-empty reason; a blank reason is refused. The attest.py CLI exposes it.
retractions(root, name) maps digest to retracting act, computed on read; trace and verify_name consult it; chain renders it inline.

Tests: the refusals the design lists; backward resolution; the D-17 limit pinned by a stolen-key forgery of a retraction; PR-022 clause 4 pinned by an output-shape guard showing no counter, weight or gate reads the retraction fields; and the acceptance case replayed on a fixture chain in a temporary directory, never on the live registry.
Append-only: no act is removed or rewritten. Do not edit CLAUDE.md. The suite passes via goal_mode. Hand off to verifier.
